trust.title: Trust & safety
trust.subtitle: How Bali Bike protects renters and owners.

verify.title: Verification
verify.body: Every member verifies their email and phone. Owners verify their identity (KTP or passport). Documents are reviewed by Bali Bike staff and stored privately.

moto.title: Motorcycle rules
moto.body: Motorcycles can only be booked by members who meet the platform minimum age, hold an approved and valid SIM C licence and have a verified identity. Owners must provide the vehicle registration (STNK); listings go live only after review.

handover.title: Digital handover
handover.body: At pickup the renter shares a one-time booking code. Both sides complete a timestamped checklist with photos at pickup and return, creating a clear record of the vehicle's condition.

payments.title: Secure payments
payments.body: Payments go through a licensed payment gateway. A booking is confirmed only after the gateway confirms payment to our server. Security deposits are held and released after a successful return.

messaging.title: Private messaging
messaging.body: Renters and owners chat inside Bali Bike. Contact details are masked until a booking is confirmed, which helps prevent off-platform scams.

reviews.title: Two-way reviews
reviews.body: After each rental, renters and owners rate each other. Ratings are tied to real, completed bookings.

reporting.title: Reports & disputes
reporting.body: Report a listing, user or problem at any time. Damage, late returns and no-shows go to a dispute queue reviewed by our team using checklists, photos and messages.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.body: We collect only what's needed to operate safely and keep only the last digits of document numbers. Bali Bike is being prepared to comply with Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) before public launch.

terms.title: Rental agreement & terms
terms.subtitle: The rules every Bali Bike booking follows.
terms.draftBody: This agreement is a working draft for the MVP and must be reviewed by an Indonesian legal professional before public launch.

scope.title: The Bali Bike platform
scope.body: Bali Bike is a marketplace that connects vehicle owners with renters. Bali Bike is not the owner of listed vehicles and is not a party to the rental itself, except for processing payments and operating dispute resolution.

parties.title: Owner and renter responsibilities
parties.body: Owners confirm they legally own or are authorised to rent the vehicle, that it is roadworthy and that listing details are accurate. Renters agree to use the vehicle lawfully and carefully, only for personal transport, and to return it on time in the same condition.

booking.title: Bookings
booking.body: A booking request becomes binding when the owner accepts it and the payment provider confirms payment. Both parties accept this agreement when the booking is made.

payment.title: Prices and payment
payment.body: Prices are set by owners. Renters are charged the cheapest combination of the owner's published prices for the booked duration. Bali Bike deducts a platform commission from the owner's earnings.

deposit.title: Security deposit
deposit.body: If the listing has a deposit, it is held during the rental and released after a successful return, minus any late fees or amounts awarded in a dispute.

cancellation.title: Cancellations
cancellation.body: Renters can cancel free of charge before payment. After payment, cancelling at least 24 hours before pickup gives a full refund; later cancellations refund 50% of the rental price plus the full deposit. If an owner cancels, the renter is refunded in full.

late.title: Late returns and extensions
late.body: Renters may extend a rental if the vehicle is free, by paying the additional amount. Returns later than the grace period incur a late fee per started hour.

responsibility.title: Damage and responsibility
responsibility.body: The renter is responsible for the vehicle from pickup until return, including fines incurred during the rental. Damage is documented using the handover checklists and photos.

motorcycles.title: Motorcycles
motorcycles.body: Motorcycle renters must meet the platform minimum age, hold a valid SIM C licence and carry their ID and the vehicle's STNK while riding. Helmets meeting the SNI standard must be worn.

disputes.title: Disputes
disputes.body: Either party may open a dispute. Bali Bike reviews the evidence and may award part or all of the deposit to the owner or release it to the renter.

data.title: Personal data
data.body: Personal data is processed only to provide the service, verify members and keep the platform safe, in line with applicable Indonesian personal data protection law.
